pairs.description: Chronic use of stimulant aloe latex laxatives causes potassium depletion, dramatically sensitizing the heart to fatal digoxin arrhythmias.
pairs.mechanism: Aloin-induced enteric electrolyte wasting leading to systemic hypokalemia and elevated cardiac glycoside sensitivity.

pairs.description: Concomitant oral ingestion of aloe latex with thiazide diuretics causes synergistic potassium wasting and acute severe hypokalemia.
pairs.mechanism: Dual potassium-wasting effects across the renal distal convoluted tubule and enteric colonic mucosa.

pairs.description: Oral aloe vera inner leaf preparations possess hypoglycemic properties that may compound insulin therapy, risking hypoglycemic episodes.
pairs.mechanism: Stimulation of pancreatic insulin synthesis and secretion alongside enhanced peripheral glucose utilization.
